sow verb

Traupman 166

serō, serere, sēvī, satum

verb, third conjugation

sow, plant

Other words

  • plantō, plantāre — set (a plant, a cutting) in the ground

    verb, first conjugation · also used · post-classical · Plin. NH 17.67: hōc modō plantantur Pūnicae (Lewis & Short); Pall. 4.5 (Lewis & Short)

    From planta, a cutting or seedling. The classical writers say serere or pōnere.

Examples

  • quī ūnum phasēlum sēvit et quīnquāgintā lēgit

    who planted one bean and picked fiftycomposed

See also pick, tend the garden, grow, transplant, furrow, seed, nursery.
